title: Comprehensive Comment Report
purpose: Static HTML comment-report template that renders a list of comment cards (author + role, avatar, sentiment, priority, status, tag, reference id) with a NITDA watermark. A print/report export layout, not an interactive app.

offerings.name: Comment report card
offerings.description: Per-comment card: author name + role, circular avatar with a sentiment-coloured ring, timestamp, status badge (Pending/Reviewed/Resolved), comment body, priority tag (Urgent/Medium/Low), sentiment chip with face icon (Negative/Positive/Neutral), and a comment reference id (e.g. #CMT-2045).

offerings.name: Report header & footer
offerings.description: Centered title 'Comprehensive Comment Report', generation date/time (WAT), and a footer with total-comments count and NITDA copyright.

offerings.name: Watermark branding
offerings.description: Low-opacity NITDA logo watermark layer behind each card.

dom_contract.notes: Entirely inline-styled; no ids or classes. Repeated card structure (watermark layer + content layer).

event_handling.notes: No JavaScript and no event handlers — pure static markup.

state_management: None — static markup; comment data is hard-coded into the template.

design_tokens.spacing_or_layout_notes: 24px page padding; 32px gaps between cards; 10px rounded cards with 1px border and soft shadow; flex header rows (avatar + name + status), wrap tag row.

accessibility.notes: Decorative SVG icons marked aria-hidden; images have alt text. No interactive/focusable elements.

localization.notes: English copy; date shown in WAT.

risks_and_quirks: Placeholder assets: [BASE64_LOGO] token and example.com avatar URLs — not production assets.
Presentation/report template only; the interactive comment thread is implemented elsewhere (platform pf-comment-thread). This file is a print/report export, not an app surface.
Minor markup corruption around the third card's avatar style attribute.
